Coram:- Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Amarjot Bhatti

Present:- Ms. Manpreet Ghuman, Advocate
 for the petitioner (through video conferencing).

Perusal of record shows that first regular bail petition filed by petitioner- Jagraj Singh @ Chand i.e. CRM-M-37876-2025 was decided on merits vide order dated 05.09.2025 and again present regular bail petition has been filed on 06.10.2025 without disclosing about the fate of first regular bail petition.
2. Learned counsel for petitioner states that she was not aware of the first regular bail petition filed by present petitioner.

Therefore, she does not want to pursue the present regular bail petition filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail in FIR No.158 dated 18.07.2024, under Sections 376, 420, 120-B of IPC, registered at Police Station Jamalpur, District Ludhiana and wants to withdraw the same.
3. In the aforesaid scenario, learned counsel for petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present regular bail petition and the same stands dismissed as withdrawn, accordingly.
4. Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, stand disposed of accordingly as well.
